messages:
Alex: :rotating_light: Heads up - I'm seeing multiple alerts in alert-router for high tail-latency on inference-frontend but nothing was paged to the oncall rota. Checked the alert logs, router shows POSTs to /notify-webhook succeeded with 200, but external paging provider shows no incoming webhooks.
Priya: Hmm, I'm on it. Are these recent? any customer-impacting pages we missed?
Alex: Started ~12:13 UTC, maybe ~30-40 alerts over the last 10m. Customer support just flagged two customers complaining about timeouts around the same time.
Priya: Okay pinging oncall-bot to see if it created an incident thread.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2345 for inference latency (auto). No ACKs. (this is a system message)
Sam: I pulled the webhook delivery logs from the notify-proxy. We're getting 200 from our side but the paging provider is returning 202 -> then a few seconds later 429 on retry. On retries our suppressor backoff kicks in and marks that destination as "muted". Looks like the suppressor interpreted a TTL header incorrectly and set a long mute.
Mia: Can you paste the relevant log snippet?
Sam: Sure — here's the notify-proxy -> paging-provider exchange:
```
POST /ext/pager HTTP/1.1
Host: pager-example.com
Authorization: Bearer ***
Payload: {"incident":"INC-2026-2345","sev":"p1"}
Response 202 Accepted
--- retry ---
Response 429 Too Many Requests
Rate-Limit-Reset: 60
```
And our suppressor log:
```
suppressor: destination=pager-example mute_until=Wed Dec 31 2099 23:59:59 GMT parse_error: ttl="0xdeadbeef"
```
Priya: Oof. parse_error and a far-future mute — that's why pages were silent. That suppressor TTL parser regression was introduced in the last deploy (release 2026.3.8).
Alex: Can we revert the suppressor config or disable auto-mute? We need to ensure pages go out while we triage.
Mia: I can flip a feature flag to disable auto-mute for external providers. Doing it now.
Mia: :gear: Feature flag disable_auto_mute=ON for env=prod (patch applied)
Alex: Confirmed manual page went through after flag flip — I just triggered a test page to the oncall rota:
```
curl -X POST https://notify.redwood.internal/test-page -d '{"msg":"test page - please ignore"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer internal-test'
```
ops-bot: Manual page delivered to OnCall rotation (round-robin) at 12:26 UTC
Priya: Good. Turning flag off is a safe mitigation but we should revert the faulty suppressor parsing in the codebase.
Sam: Agreed. I opened a quick fix branch parsing/ttl-fix and will push a hotpatch to staging, then prod. Also adding a unit test for malformed TTL values.
Alex: Meanwhile, support needs a short blurb for affected customers (we had 2 reported plus internal monitoring). Priya can you draft? Keep it transparent: missed pages due to our paging integration suppression bug.
Priya: Drafting now and will share in #customer-status for review. Also creating INC-2026-2345 EPIC to track root cause, roll-forward, and postmortem.
Mia: Post-incident TODOs: 1) revert suppressor parser in prod, 2) add a canary test that actually simulates a 429 reply and ensures we don't mute permanently, 3) add a dashboard for suppressor mute counts and longest mute duration, 4) update runbook to include manual override steps (feature flag + curl test).
Sam: I'm going to push the hotfix in 20m. Will call for a brief maintenance deploy and coordinate with Alex for rollout.
Alex: Thanks. Assigning follow-ups: Sam -> hotfix PR + tests, Mia -> feature-flag runbook and add canary test, Priya -> customer comms + incident EPIC. I'll keep this thread updated as we deploy.
Priya: Customer comms posted to #customer-status and sent to affected accounts. Short note: "We've identified and mitigated an issue with our paging integration that could have prevented some on-call notifications — we've applied a temporary mitigation and are rolling a fix. We'll follow up with a full postmortem." :thumbsup:
Sam: Hotfix PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/notify-proxy/pulls/789 — patch fixes TTL parsing + adds unit tests. Marking for expedited review.
Alex: Deploy started (canary) 12:54 UTC. I'll watch mute_count metrics.
Mia: Canary looks clean, mute_count for pager-example dropped to 0 after rollout.
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded to prod at 13:02 UTC.
Alex: All paging deliveries verified for last 30m, oncall received pages, and no further customer reports. Closing the active mitigation. Will schedule postmortem sync tomorrow 09:30 PST. Thanks everyone.
Priya: Adding link to incident EPIC and assigning postmortem owner.
Mia: Add action to run a yearly verification of external integration edge cases. :eyes:
Alex: Final note — add integration tests to our CI that assert we don't create multi-day mutes for any reasonable TTL input. That's how this escaped.
Sam: Affirmative. I'll include test and a follow-up ticket for observability improvements.
Priya: Filing incident report and postmortem draft now. Will ping when ready.
Alex: :white_check_mark: Closing thread for now. If anything else pops up, re-open.
